title: Count votes per choice
prompt: Write `voteCounts(votes: string[]): Map<string, number>`. Return a `Map` from each choice to how many times it appears. An empty string is a blank vote and counts as its own choice. Keys keep the order they first appear in.
hints: Read the current count before you set the new one.
A choice not in the map yet starts at 0. `counts.get(vote) ?? 0` handles that.
Set the same key again when a choice repeats.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Records that a choice appeared but not how many times.
Skips blank votes because `""` is falsy.

feedback: Read the current count before you set the new one.
